title: Rowan Bell · Community Manager · call with Gilda Lanternmore · January 2025
notice: Synthetic demo material. Invented document; no real meeting, publication, email or call occurred.

blocks.text: First, she confirmed she renewed the arrangement with the Meadowbank library. Starting this month, they'll deliver a rotating selection of large-print books and audiobooks monthly. She said it's a relief for residents who can't easily get to the library, especially those with vision trouble.

Second, she is preparing a grant application. The application is for a local charitable trust, seeking funds for a monthly supply of hearing aid batteries. The target is low-income residents. She said the cost adds up and it's a barrier for some.
She mentioned she's still gathering the final cost estimates and resident income information for the application. No draft is submitted yet.
